name: Limerence
source:
It's that time of year again... The manor has a new guest. For years, Freya's watched those pretty brunette girls go in the large house but never leave again. She waited to see who it would be this time but what will happen when she finds herself waking up in an unfamiliar bed?

[From [url=https://lakeanemone.itch.io/limerence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又到了一年中的这个时候……庄园迎来了一位新客人。多年来，芙蕾雅看着那些漂亮的黑发女孩走进大房子，但再也没有离开过。她等着看这一次是谁，但当她发现自己在一张陌生的床上醒来时，会发生什么呢？

[来自[url=https://lakeanemone.itch.io/limerence]Itch.io[/url]]
